gold_run.note: official streaming pgen, VOLTA70/single, 128 cells x 32 ppc0, drifts ±0.2c, t_final=50 (stats end at t=49.44; the t=50 snapshot was lost to the known harmless teardown abort)

note: Frozen from the 2026-08-09 gold run on astro (V100). Two-stream is GROWTH physics: the neutral-streaming conservation criteria (drift retention, B1 background, E^2 noise ceiling) were replaced by growth-rate band, growth factor, and saturation checks. Bands carry ~±50% margin around the gold observations so a correct re-run passes while a broken build/physics fails.

particle_count_conservation.definition: Macro-particle count per species must not change between first and last particle snapshot (periodic box).

min_particles_per_species.definition: Enough macro-particles per species are sampled at the last particle snapshot for statistics to be meaningful.
min_particles_per_species.formula: min over species of N_sp_sampled(t_last) >= tolerance
min_particles_per_species.calibration: gold sampled 102 per streaming species (8 ppc x 128 cells / stride 10); floor set at ~60%

stats_time_monotonic.definition: Stats time column strictly increases and contains no NaN/Inf (output sanity).

energy_relative_drift.definition: Total energy (T00) conserved within discretization error across the whole run (growth physics moves energy between channels; the total must still hold).
energy_relative_drift.formula: max over stats rows of abs(T00(t) - T00(t0)) / T00(t0) <= tolerance

e1_growth_rate.definition: Linear-growth rate of the two-stream instability: least-squares slope of ln(<E1^2>) over the auto window (first point above 10x noise floor through the peak), divided by 2 (field amplitude rate).
e1_growth_rate.calibration: gold gamma = 0.1366 (window [0.69, 13.81], 22 points); cold symmetric two-stream theory (±0.2c, 0.5 n0 per beam) gives ~0.1-0.15; band is gold ±50% and covers theory

e1_squared_growth_factor.definition: <E1^2> must rise well above the numerical noise floor — the instability must actually grow.
e1_squared_growth_factor.calibration: gold factor 7.08e3 (noise 4.83e-7 -> peak 3.42e-3); floor at ~1/7 of gold

saturation_before_final.definition: The instability must saturate inside the simulated time: <E1^2> peaks strictly before the final stats time.
saturation_before_final.calibration: gold peak at t=13.81 vs final 49.44
